facts.fact: Times of Eswatini reports a Gambian delegation led by an official of the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy took part in a Smart Africa gender impact assessment co-creation workshop in Mbabane, the tools being co-developed with Eswatini; the workshop date is not given, so the 2026-10-07 publication date is used.

systems.system: Smart Africa Gender Impact Assessment Framework

note: Co-development and attendance at a workshop, with no signed agreement stated, is member at most.
